title: CATS: Conformalized Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh、Aleksandar Bojchevski（科隆大学）；Soroush H. Zargarbashi、Simone Antonelli（CISPA 亥姆霍兹信息安全中心）
paper_type_zh: 带保形风险控制的自适应测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要在推理质量风险与延迟之间设置明确约束的读者。
one_line: CATS selects the least costly reasoning-effort level that satisfies a conformal bound on the probability of an incorrect answer.
CATS 在给定错误风险上限下，为每个问题自动选择成本最低的推理强度。
why: It turns adaptive thinking into a risk-controlled decision rather than an unconstrained heuristic for saving compute.
inclusion_reason: It chooses test-time reasoning effort under an explicit, user-set statistical risk constraint rather than only optimizing average compute.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models increasingly expose discrete effort settings, but choosing “low” or “high” effort per query is often a heuristic. Always using high effort wastes latency on easy questions; choosing low effort too aggressively can silently raise the error rate. A useful deployment policy needs to specify not only an average cost objective but also what probability of failure it is prepared to accept.

CATS asks how to select a reasoning-effort level while controlling the chance of an incorrect answer below a user-specified tolerance. The decision surface is a prompt paired with predicted success at each effort level, and the intended output is the cheapest eligible level rather than simply the level that appears most confident.

推理模型越来越多地提供离散的思考强度设置，但针对每个问题选择“低”还是“高”强度常依赖启发式规则。始终使用高强度会在简单问题上浪费延迟；过于激进地选择低强度又会悄悄提高错误率。可用的部署策略不仅要说明平均成本目标，还应说明自己愿意接受多大的失败概率。

CATS 研究如何选择推理强度，同时把错误答案的概率控制在用户指定的容忍度以下。其决策面是提示及各强度下的预测成功率，目标输出是满足条件的最低成本强度，而非看起来最自信的强度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CATS combines a success-probability estimate with conformal risk control. It treats each available reasoning-effort level as an action with a different cost and success profile, then calibrates a rule that selects an effort level only when its error risk is compatible with the requested tolerance. Easier prompts can therefore be served with less thinking, while harder prompts receive more effort or are handled conservatively.

The central contribution is a guarantee on the selected policy's error probability under the calibration assumptions, not merely a learned prediction of difficulty. This changes adaptive test-time scaling from “guess how hard to think” into a contract: the user sets a risk level, the system chooses effort subject to that level, and cost reduction is pursued only within the constraint.

CATS 将成功概率估计与保形风险控制结合起来。它把每个可用推理强度视为成本和成功特性不同的动作，再校准一项规则：只有当某强度的错误风险符合所请求容忍度时才选择它。简单提示因而可以少思考，困难提示获得更多强度或被保守处理。

核心贡献是在校准假设下，对所选策略错误概率作出保证，而不只是学习一个难度预测。这把自适应测试时扩展从“猜该思考多难”变成一份契约：用户设定风险水平，系统在该水平约束下选择强度，成本降低只能在此限制内追求。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method estimates the chance that a model succeeds under each discrete reasoning level and applies conformal calibration to those estimates. Given a new prompt and a target error tolerance, it selects an appropriate effort level while enforcing the risk-control rule. The result is an inference-time controller; it does not claim to alter the base model's weights or to create new reasoning data.

Evaluation tests whether the controller can choose levels automatically while preserving the requested reliability boundary and using lower effort on easy instances. The official paper is a CAO Workshop at ICLR 2026 oral. No code or data repository is linked in the checked primary record, so a reproduction must recover the calibration split, effort-level interface, and risk metric from the paper before treating the guarantee as portable.

该方法估计模型在各离散推理强度下成功的概率，并对这些估计应用保形校准。给定新提示和目标错误容忍度，它在执行风险控制规则的同时选择合适强度。结果是一个推理时控制器；它不声称改变基础模型权重，也不构造新的推理数据。

评测检验控制器能否自动选择强度，同时保持所要求的可靠性边界，并在简单实例上使用较低强度。官方论文是 ICLR 2026 的 CAO Workshop oral。所核验主记录未链接代码或数据仓库，因此复现前必须从论文恢复校准划分、强度接口和风险指标，才能把该保证视为可迁移的。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official abstract reports that CATS automatically selects a reasoning level while guaranteeing that the probability of an incorrect answer stays below a user-chosen tolerance. This directly supports the paper's primary claim: adaptation is evaluated as controlled risk, not only as a mean accuracy or latency improvement.

The available primary record does not expose a public implementation or data bundle, so the evidence should be read at the level of the published experimental setting. A reviewer should inspect the full tables for the calibration distribution, tolerance values, and whether the reported guarantee is empirical or finite-sample conditional before converting it into a production service-level objective.

官方摘要报告，CATS 能自动选择推理强度，并保证错误答案的概率低于用户选择的容忍度。这直接支持论文的主要主张：自适应是按受控风险评估，而不仅是按平均准确率或延迟改善评估。

现有主记录没有公开实现或数据包，因此证据应限定在已发表的实验设置层面。把它转化为生产服务级目标前，审阅者应检查完整表格中的校准分布、容忍度取值，以及所报告保证是经验性的还是有限样本条件性的。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many adaptive-thinking methods estimate difficulty and then optimize an informal quality-cost trade-off. CATS changes the decision criterion by attaching conformal risk control to the selected effort. The novel object is therefore a calibrated effort-selection set with a user-defined failure constraint, not simply another learned stopping score.

This does not make the controller immune to deployment shift: the guarantee relies on the calibration setup and the available effort levels. Its distinct value is that it makes the desired safety boundary explicit and auditable, allowing readers to ask whether a claimed compute saving occurred while preserving the promised error tolerance.

许多自适应思考方法先估计难度，再优化非正式的质量—成本权衡。CATS 通过把保形风险控制附加到所选强度上，改变了决策准则。因此新对象是带用户定义失败约束的校准强度选择集合，而非又一个学习得到的停止分数。

这并不使控制器免于部署漂移：保证依赖校准设置和可用强度等级。它的独特价值在于使所需安全边界明确且可审计，让读者能追问所声称的计算节省是否在保留承诺错误容忍度的条件下发生。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Risk control depends on the calibration distribution resembling deployment and on success estimates remaining valid after model or prompt changes. Discrete effort choices may also be too coarse for workloads that need fine-grained token, tool, or branch budgets. The lack of released code and data makes it harder to verify the exact calibration procedure, and a deployment should monitor coverage after every model, prompt, or traffic change rather than treating an offline guarantee as permanent.
风险控制依赖校准分布与部署相似，并依赖模型或提示改变后成功估计仍然有效。离散强度选择对于需要细粒度令牌、工具或分支预算的负载也可能过粗。缺少发布的代码和数据使精确校准流程更难核验；部署应在每次模型、提示或流量改变后监测覆盖率，而不能把离线保证视为永久有效。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CATS when a product owner can state an acceptable answer-error rate and the base model exposes selectable reasoning effort. The implementation checklist is to define the effort actions and their costs, hold out calibration data, decide the error event precisely, and monitor post-deployment coverage by workload slice. It is more appropriate for a controlled reliability policy than for maximizing raw benchmark score under an unrestricted compute budget.
当产品负责人能够明确可接受的答案错误率，且基础模型提供可选推理强度时，可使用 CATS。实现清单包括定义强度动作及其成本、留出校准数据、精确定义错误事件，并按工作负载切片监测部署后的覆盖率。它更适合受控可靠性策略，而非在不受限制的计算预算下最大化原始基准分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper's key contribution is not merely detecting easy questions; it makes the error tolerance a user-facing input to effort selection. Separate the risk guarantee from the cost reduction, because the latter is valuable only under the former. Record the calibration distribution and the available effort levels whenever comparing results. The official venue signal is an ICLR 2026 CAO Workshop oral, while public implementation artifacts were not linked in the checked record.
论文的关键贡献不只是识别简单问题，而是把错误容忍度设为强度选择的面向用户输入。应将风险保证与成本降低分开，因为后者只有在前者成立时才有价值。比较结果时应记录校准分布和可用强度等级。官方会议信号为 ICLR 2026 CAO Workshop oral，而所核验记录没有链接公开实现工件。
